title: nfvir pipeline parameters
description: A simple viromics pipeline to mine viral genomes in a metagenome

assembly.description: Path to a single co-assembly FASTA file (mutually exclusive with --assemblies)
assembly.help_text: The metagenomic assembly in FASTA format (can be gzipped). Omit both --assembly and --assemblies to assemble each sample with MEGAHIT.

assemblies.description: Path to a CSV file listing multiple assemblies (mutually exclusive with --assembly)
assemblies.help_text: CSV with columns: assemblyID, fasta. Each assemblyID is used as a prefix for viral sequence IDs before cross-assembly dereplication.

reads.description: Path to the CSV file containing sample reads
reads.help_text: CSV file with columns: sampleID, reads_R1, reads_R2

genomad_db.description: Path to the geNomad database directory
genomad_db.help_text: Directory containing the geNomad database (must contain genomad_mini_db.index)

checkv_db.description: Path to the CheckV database directory

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved

download_publish_mode.description: How downloaded database files are published to --outdir. hardlink requires work and outdir on the same filesystem; symlinks are not supported.

max_cpus.description: Maximum number of CPUs that can be requested for any single job

max_memory.description: Maximum amount of memory that can be requested for any single job

max_time.description: Maximum amount of time that can be requested for any single job

genomad_cleanup.description: Delete geNomad intermediate files after the run
genomad_cleanup.help_text: Passes --cleanup to geNomad end-to-end. Intermediate MMseqs2 databases and other temporary files are not needed by the pipeline and can consume a lot of disk space.

checkv_min_quality.description: Minimum CheckV quality tier retained for dereplication
checkv_min_quality.help_text: Sequences below this tier are excluded before clustering. Use 'all' (default) to keep every geNomad virus, including sequences with no CheckV completeness estimate ('Not-determined').

minimap.description: Use minimap2 instead of BWA for read mapping
minimap.help_text: BWA is used by default. Set this flag to map reads with minimap2 instead.
